# One Dark

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark)

One Dark is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. Added in 6.31.0.

> **Name clash:** `@codemirror/theme-one-dark` also exports `oneDark`. When both packages are installed, alias one
> of them on import, for example `import { oneDark as fsOneDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark'`,
> and add only one One Dark theme to an editor.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `oneDark` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { oneDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-one-dark';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, oneDark],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `oneDark` | `Extension` |
| `oneDarkMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#282c34` |
| Active line | `#2c313c` |
| Selection | `#363c49` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#d688ee` | - | 5.74:1 | 5.35:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#d688ee` | - | 5.74:1 | 5.35:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#56b6c2` | - | 5.91:1 | 5.50:1 | 4.67:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#abb2bf` | - | 6.57:1 | 6.11:1 | 5.19:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#f9828a` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.33:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#f9828a` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.33:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#61afef` | - | 5.92:1 | 5.51:1 | 4.68:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#f9828a` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.33:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#e5c07b` | - | 8.10:1 | 7.54:1 | 6.40:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#e5c07b` | - | 8.10:1 | 7.54:1 | 6.40:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#e5c07b` | - | 8.10:1 | 7.54:1 | 6.40:1 |
| String | `string` | `#98c379` | - | 6.94:1 | 6.46:1 | 5.48:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#56b6c2` | - | 5.91:1 | 5.50:1 | 4.67:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#d29b67` | - | 5.75:1 | 5.35:1 | 4.54:1 |

| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#f9828a` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.33:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#9fa6b5` | italic | 5.73:1 | 5.33:1 | 4.53:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#abb2bf` | background, active line, selection | 5.19:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#8b93a6` | gutter | 4.55:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#528bff` | background, active line | 4.03:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#61afef` | background | 5.92:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #abb2bf` | background, active line | 6.11:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#61afef66, 1px solid #61afef` | background (fill or outline) | 5.92:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#363c49` | active line | 1.18:1 | Pass |
